design_choices.unresolved_excluded: origin unresolved / excluded / unknown (e.g. implied_by_usage) -> kind 'unclassified' with note '<origin>: <reason>' (brief: keep as-is in note)
design_choices.seed_paper_caveat: rag_literature lineage always maps to other_paper, even when its only source is tagged 'seed_paper'; the tag is never used to upgrade a row to 'paper' (rag/conform.py ~283: the tag is not a reliable seed test). rag_provenance with source_id seed_paper adds no record; any other rag_provenance source adds an other_paper / database record unless lineage already gave that (kind, source). sources['seed_paper'] carries a note saying so. Effect: paper-only can only show less, never more
design_choices.database_records: one record per lineage entry; source = first source's table id; other source ids listed in note; all registered in the sources table (id = source_id for papers, '<source_type>:<id>' for databases unless already prefixed)
design_choices.quote: paper and other_paper records carry the row's evidence string as quote
design_choices.paper_meta: stored as sources['paper']; paper records then point source 'paper' (else null)
design_choices.paper_only: keeps base processes with a paper record; prunes compounds, proteins, complexes, nucleic acids, element collections to those referenced by kept processes (and kept complexes' components) or with their own paper record; species, subcellular locations, cell types, tissues, compartments pass through; element_locations dropped only when their element was in the base and is no longer in the view; a state is dropped only when base rows used it and no kept row does; all other top-level keys (reaction_order, source_text_index, quarantine reports ...) pass through unchanged
design_choices.hops: base rows 0; an extension process = 1 + min hop of the entities it shares (base entities and any name a base process uses count as 0); extension entities take the min hop of processes using them; extension location rows take their entity's hop, states their users' min hop; extension rows are never below 1; unreachable -> null (FULL only)
design_choices.merge_identity: entities: shared grounded id (chebi/kegg/hmdb/pubchem/pathbank/uniprot/drugbank fields and mapped_ids, same section) then normalized name or synonym; reactions: identity sets of inputs/outputs in either orientation; other rows: their signature. Entity names in new extension process/location rows are rewritten to the matched row's name so the view stays reference-closed
